## Description and Rationale

SkyNet A dedicated group of telecom engineers and software developers from Kyiv Aviation Institute, passionate about aviation data structures, 5G architectures, and low-latency radar telemetry (ASTERIX CAT 062). We are participating to redefine how airport ground movement is modeled. We believe that integrating telecommunications principles—like 5G RF-sensing concepts and network-based data reconstruction—into ML pipelines is the key to eliminating sensor blind spots and predicting highly accurate taxi-out times for Europe’s busiest airports.

## Details

* Type: Academia
* Country: Ukraine
* Number of team members: 2
